_doc: Placement tiers that auto-place a crash without GPS (locate.Gate). A tier is added only by a user decision (docs/03): exact (>= 98% Wilson 95% lower bound on hidden-truth tests); unique_pair (user 2026-10-22, #211 evidence: at or above exact on hidden police GPS and LAPD open data). Street pairs that meet in more than one place still go to review. tiger_only_auto (#229): false = a placement that needs a road only TIGER/Line has goes to review with the suggestion; TIGER names on an OSM way keep their tier's gate. The user decides after run 9. verified_typo (#233, user 2026-10-22): a misspelled name corrected to the one map street within max_edits (short_max_edits for names of short_core letters or fewer; names under min_core letters and digits never changed), no rival within one more edit, the corrected pair meeting at one intersection, police GPS (when present) within gps_check_ft. Not in auto_tiers: a suggestion until the Tester measures it and the user approves. freeway_offset (#246, D1, user 2026-10-23): freeway crashes on a freeway corridor placed by the report (mainline from the reference street's crossing, ramp terminal, connector from the second freeway); not in auto_tiers until the Tester measures it and the user approves; while off it's a suggestion and GPS is left as it is. 2026-10-24 (user, #255): freeway_offset auto-places freeway crashes with no usable GPS, as provenance approximate (approximate_mi); approximate crashes are never assigned to an intersection, so intersection tables and collision diagrams leave them out and say how many. Officer GPS that fits the named roads is never moved by the freeway report (user 2026-10-25, replacing the 2026-10-23 rule; #259 removed freeway_move_gps). freeway_auto_kinds (user 2026-10-25, #259): the freeway descriptions freeway_offset auto-places; a true connector ("X TO Y" whose cross street is X or Y) is held for review with its suggestion; connector_local, an "X TO Y" naming a local cross street, is placed on X like mainline (user, later 2026-10-25). postmile (#319, user 2026-11-01): a no-GPS report giving a mile marker on the state route, placed at that Caltrans postmile (mile_marker.py); not in auto_tiers until the Tester measures it and the user approves; while off it's the review list's suggestion.
